notes.title: Patch Notes: Build 1.04 "Target Acquired"
notes.content:
This patch introduces a fully reworked turret targeting system that makes defenses feel more intelligent and responsive. Raids now give Energy Cycle rewards per length completed. You’ll also find key balance updates, more input flexibility (especially on Steam Deck), and fixes that polish the game across the board.

[h3]Added:[/h3]
[list]
[*] New turret targeting system! Target options are gained through biased sampling and chosen based on weighted values:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43358829/dbb6715dfd02c9567263a36c280821362b36a1cb.gif[/img]
[list]
[*] Health – High-damage turrets aim for tankier enemies.
[*] Rotation – Fast-rotating turrets scan around for the best target; slow ones stick to what’s in front.
[*] Distance – Most turrets prefer nearby enemies, Minigun Turrets more so than artillery turrets.[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43358829/b71e1ace8889208d1904a5bb5b98a75123dce99d.gif[/img]
[/list]

[h3]Balance:[/h3]
[list]
[*] Raids now reward 1 Energy Cycle per completed length (Short = 1, Medium = 2, Long = 3, Epic = 4).
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43358829/468045a7623d285e9eaa5fd70473f4ca53fc70e1.jpg[/img]
[*] Room max counts raised:
[list]
[*] Asteroid Miner: 8 → 10
[*] Farm: 6 → 8
[*] Purifier: 6 → 8
[*] Refinery: 6 → 8
[/list]
[*] Encounter rate changes:
[list]
[*] Gold Bug: 15 → 20
[*] Tree Eater: 20 → 15
[*] Lightning Storm: 30 → 25[/list]
[*] Lightning Storm damage reduced from 200 → 100
[/list]

[h3]Changes:[/h3]
[list]
[*] Build confirmation skip instructions now shown in the Rebind screen on "Selection Modifier".
[*] More secondary binding options on desktop.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43358829/301ec49777f33789b969aa79be9e4d1692aabadc.jpg[/img]
[*] Infected enemies now appear even after completing the story.
[*] Report/Email buttons removed from Steam Deck UI.
[*] Steam Deck now defaults to gamepad controls.
[*] Click tutorial indicator now says “Press”.
[*] Orb and Drop Select now use separate bindings (both default to TAB).
[/list]

[h3]Fixes:[/h3]
[list]
[*] Extreme Raids stay active after restarting.
[*] Raid status updates correctly when switching profiles.
[*] Input glyphs are now displayed more consistently.
[*] Comms Hub shows correct max count.
[*] Secret rewards no longer spoil themselves in tooltips.
[*] Planet tooltips no loner displayed when over other UI.
[*] Extreme difficulty won’t auto-select when not unlocked.
[*] Inactive Growth sources won’t be reactivated if Growth is added mid-mission.
[/list]

Thanks again for playing and sending in your thoughts. Your feedback shapes every patch. Keep it coming!

notes.title: Patch Notes: Build 1.03 "Comms Hub"
notes.content:
Another patch filled with fixes and requested features. The new Extreme Raid "Wastelands", pushes your skill and endurance to the limit. Bans and Re-Rolls are now tied to the new Comms Hub in the Space Station. Clay's Repair Kit brings more healing to your toolkit. The new Slow Motion Scale enables you to do almost a tactical paus, where things can still be moved and and used.

[h3]Added:[/h3][list]
[*] Extreme Raid "Wastelands". Prepare for a challenge like never before.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43358829/c2aa7987241698e5c3aaa4daea36686b15046100.jpg[/img][*] Comms Hub. New Space Station Room: Each active Comms Hub gives 2 Bans and 2 Re-Rolls.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43358829/58002361312b63d2d382ac7b4c9122d5d393f7c1.jpg[/img]
[*] Clay Repair Kit Run Modifier. Heals himself and everything nearby.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43358829/ac0b9eb30b6e3f23ab5630149cf9fd752ac45387.jpg[/img]
[*] Slow Motion Scale Slider in Settings. Adjust how much the game slows down during slow motion.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43358829/c68747d6f5ee25cd6abded0055070cb126522ce6.gif[/img]
[*] Save Icon Pop-Up when the game saves your current state.
[/list]

[h3]Balance:[/h3][list]
[*] Q main range increased 3 → 4, special increased 4 → 5.
[*] Fewer mission modifiers at the start of harder missions.
[*] Lightning Storm appears less often: 40 → 30.
[*] Bride of Idun and Acid Boi health regen scaling with Challenge is now 10x lower.
[*] Planet mission achievement reduced: 500 → 250.
[/list]

[h3]Changes:[/h3][list]
[*] Bans and Re-Rolls now scale with the number of active Comms Hubs.
[*] Unique icon added for Ban.
[*] Enemy unit tooltips now show more accurate range values.
[*] Slow-motion bound to keyboard 'N' by default.
[*] Larger text during tutorial and outro screen.
[*] Excavator information images updated.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43358829/75feef5a07d35a91342a6aa436327355b16b0526.jpg[/img]
[/list]

[h3]Fixes:[/h3][list]
[*] Deep Dive's gates will properly close when restarting the mission.
[*] Modifiers now reset correctly on mission restart.
[*] Hard Raid Achievement now has the correct goal count.
[*] User report only requires a single symbol to activate the Submit button.
[*] Rayn's Range Upgrade description now correctly says "hero" instead of "turret".
[*] Turrets near lakes will now fire correctly.
[*] Mine Deposit collider now match the size of the Mine building.
[*] Steam Deck: Default resolution set to 1280 x 800
[*] Steam Deck: Text input prompt opens and closes directly with the virtual keyboard.
[/list]

Thanks for sticking with IDUN and helping me shape it into something better with every patch. Keep the feedback coming!

notes.title: Patch Notes: Build 1.00 "End Game" - Spring Sale Now Live With 15% Discount!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43358829/c0fe8eaee853ed7945f09275edd262dd7e3aa7db.gif[/img]
IDUN hits Build 100 with a massive update! A new cinematic wraps up the story, and Ro-Ro joins as a deployable hero after finishing the campaign. Extreme Difficulty & Epic Raids unlocks for those who seek the ultimate challenge. Rock Piercer is now a fully implemented hero! The game is now fully localized in Russian and Korean, big thanks to everyone who helped out! 

We are currently participating in the Steam Spring Sale, with the game available at a 15% discount. If you haven't played the full game yet, grab it now!

[h3]Added:[/h3]
[list]
[*] New cinematic when finishing the last mission (Drill or Die).
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43358829/fadd60e05dabdf28fa69634df183ac5bf32b921b.jpg[/img]
[*] Ro-Ro becomes a deployable hero after completing the story campaign. Play Drill or Die to unlock!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43358829/2c6648c61283ed9f6b01a42b1f3e0ab9a28e5ddf.gif[/img]
[*] Full localization in Russian and Korean.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43358829/6d5ec5401f13adf58fb7a87cc8767a52bd83fcad.jpg[/img]
[*] Extreme Difficulty unlocks after finishing the story campaign. Survive Deep Drill for 10 minutes, mine 95% with the Excavator, and collect 10 meteors with the Mech.
[*] Epic-length Raids unlock after the story campaign. Almost twice as long as Long Raids!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43358829/a7c507b908a6db2d5c737e069342156d036ce724.png[/img]
[*] Rock Piercer is now an upgradeable hero with deployable abilities. Play Convoy to unlock.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43358829/8fc8621756c75a0df83614bbcbb2fdc55c2337b1.gif[/img]
[/list]

[h3]Balance:[/h3]
[list]
[*] Raids are harder on later missions.
[*] The final Raid mission is even more difficult.
[*] Asteroid Miner max count increased 6 → 8
[*] Farm max count increased 4 → 6
[*] Refinery max count increased 4 → 6
[*] Purifier max count increased 4 → 6
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43358829/1068ab590d3d92faddf8aaa1ead6ddcfb46c9be3.jpg[/img]
[*] Room Rewards are now spread out more across the planet.
[/list]

[h3]Changes:[/h3]
[list]
[*] Instead of purchasing turrets, Rock Piercer now uses turrets from the loadout.
[*] Health Upgrade Run Rewards for Tank and Wall will only appear if they haven't been heavily upgraded.
[*] Language selection dropdown added to the Title Screen.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43358829/bb3782f390f819ed878931400ce44871b684a490.jpg[/img]
[/list]

[h3]Fixes:[/h3]
[list]
[*] Mines built on Deposits are now easier to select.
[*] Certain achievements can no longer be completed during story missions.
[*] Added safety nets before saving on application quit to prevent corrupt saves from crashes.
[*] Bride of Idun will no longer spawn Growth after death in non-story missions.
[*] All achievement number abbreviations are now correctly localized.
[*] MANY other localization fixes across the game.
[/list]

This is a huge milestone for IDUN, and it's all thanks to you! Keep sharing your feedback, and let me know what you think of the new heroes and epic challenges!

notes.title: Patch Notes: Build 0.99 "Mines & Modifiers"
notes.content:
This update adds a Modifier Bar, letting you inspect active mission and run modifiers mid-game. The Liquid Geyser mission modifier provides a steady blue liquid flow, perfect for powering printers and pumps. Meteor Rain and Lightning Storm mission modifiers can now be removed as rewards in Orbs. Proximity mines now deploy with a cooler effect. Additional improvements include restock buttons in the Loadout Screen and a truck load of other fixes.

[h3]Added:[/h3]
[list]
[*] Modifier Bar lets you inspect active mission and run modifiers during missions.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43358829/5001d1ddb030842c26a0b574be457fe78b655b77.gif[/img]
[*] New Music Track [url=https://youtu.be/a1IR_mT9SN4?si=UuDq_XebQjXYl-v0]“Chimeria” by Dark Fantasy Studio[/url].
[*] The new Mission Modifier "Liquid Geyser". A raised rock formation with a constant flow of blue Liquid flow, 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43358829/a5c01bc62dd661df0912148123cd67d4b1c73d7c.gif[/img]
[*] Restock Buttons in the Loadout Screen.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43358829/67dab5ef00ba5ac76f387eb6d792b7791eac30e1.jpg[/img]
[*] Cooler effect when deploying proximity mines.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43358829/30bdafb68d2043479c85977c04d17fb805d57925.gif[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43358829/edc3a9f587a3065c2c388f223dc043e43b9aa97a.gif[/img]
[*] Two Run Modifiers (Orb Rewards) that lets you remove either Meteor Rain or Lightning Storm.
[/list]

[h3]Balance:[/h3]
[list]
[*] Electrified Walls push force reduced from 40 → 20.
[*] Increased visibility into Fog of War.
[*] Fog of War modifier occurs slightly less often.
[/list]

[h3]Changes:[/h3]
[list]
[*] Frozen Grass is now denser.
[*] Run Modifiers Tooltip now shows how many times they have been activated.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43358829/00f2138337ab239c7e87a0e435b47fb90f536e05.jpg[/img]
[*] Updated some quip voice lines.
[*] Related quips now uses the same time threshold. Meaning lower quip frequency.
[/list]

[h3]Fixes:[/h3]
[list]
[*] Mission Modifiers during loop events now correctly apply.
[*] Meteor Rain and Lightning Storm no longer target mission-critical buildings as often, even in crowded areas.
[*] Research Panel in the Space Station will no longer stack when clicking outside the panel.
[*] Run Modifiers (Run Rewards) now correctly reset between missions.
[*] Deep Drill Pulse Modifier no longer constantly deals trickling damage.
[*] Unlock (Research) Tooltips now consistently display icons.
[*] Gold Bug will now kill itself when exploding the first time.
[*] Smoothed gameplay edges on Spiral.
[*] Tutorial missions now show the correct challenges.
[*] Hero units now update transforms correctly, preventing rendering issues.
[*] Fog of War (and other removed modifiers) can no longer be added again during a loop event if removed as a reward.
[/list]

Thanks for playing and for all your feedback! Keep sharing your thoughts. Your input helps shape IDUN and makes each update better. Let me know what you think!

notes.title: Patch Notes: Build 0.98 "Meteor Mayhem"
notes.content:
As always, these changes are based on your feedback, so keep it coming! The Sky Gun is now locked for a shorter time, as the Deep Dive mission where it gets repaired has been moved earlier, also making it clearer that it is broken and how to fix it. This update also introduces the Meteor Rain mission modifier, bringing fiery destruction from the sky. Plus, mission modifiers can now appear during loop events. You can now filter unachieved achievements for easier tracking, and UI improvements make tooltips, scrolling, and raid loadouts clearer. Lastly, Mech controls have been improved for greater flexibility.

[h3]Added:[/h3]
[list]
[*] Meteor Rain mission modifier: Meteors will rain down, scorching and smashing everything they hit.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43358829/9898465293950f3f0509b2ebe46e914dd10099de.gif[/img]
[*] Mission modifiers are now added during loop events.
[*] Unachieved achievements can now be filtered in the in-game Achievements viewer.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43358829/3e240b4d5dd03d703286f352a718671c2df1efc9.jpg[/img]
[/list]

[h3]Balance:[/h3]
[list]
[*] Pump liquid pumping radius upgrade levels increased from 4 → 6.
[*] Deep Dive is easier on Easy and Medium.
[*] Minimum time between lightning strikes increased from 0.4 → 0.8.
[*] Lavalisk Hard Kill achievement requirement reduced from 50k → 10k.
[*] Lavalisk Very Hard Kill achievement requirement reduced from 500k → 50k.
[*] No Move mission modifier can no longer be active at the same time as Lightning Storm (or Meteor Rain).
[/list]

[h3]Changes:[/h3]
[list]
[*] It is now clearer why an item is locked. Especially when the Sky Gun is broken.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43358829/f1a3166ef0098cb9a878283d41ec350238821086.gif[/img]
[*] A moderate number of dialogue lines have been polished or updated.
[*] Anchor scrolling is now prettier.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43358829/b6d8c0c1feef9d034b9539668c0a5e9c8f84ff8e.gif[/img]
[*] Sky Gun is now broken for a shorter time, as the mission Deep Dive is moved earlier. (Switched place with Crystal Canyon)
[*] Completed Raids now display how much time remains until they are available again.
[*] Raid loadout visuals are now larger and easier to read when picking a new reward.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43358829/a74ef836835507d67f0d8f77b6fd67da747ef0ef.jpg[/img]
[*] Mission tooltips now display a colored challenge level to indicate difficulty (based on previous played missions).
[*] Mech no longer moves when dragging tools.
[*] Mech can now be moved with Camera Drag Input (Default: Middle Mouse Button). It will behave accordingly when using Anchor Scrolling.
[*] Profile names are now checked even more strictly for OS safety.
[/list]

[h3]Fixes:[/h3]
[list]
[*] Rayn Stealth material is now prettier and works correctly with selection.
[*] Stacks in the Loadout Screen now display correctly when the last equipped one is already in use after a new one is built.
[*] Dialogues Quips (not story lines) will be cut out less due to speed up.
[/list]

Keep sharing your thoughts, I’m always listening. Let's make IDUN even better together!

notes.title: Patch Notes: Build 0.97 "Hard Weight"
notes.content:
Last patch had some stability issues, I'm so sorry about that. Hopefully this patch will be more stable. Remember to enable "Send Analytics Data" if you want to help out, that way I will get the crash logs. I was actually working on endgame balancing before knowing about the crashes, so this patch also includes a lot of end game balancing. The current loop count is now displayed. A loop happens when playing a mission for a long time, and when it happens, the missions gets a lot harder.

[h3]Added:[/h3]
[list]
[*] Current Loop is now displayed with a big popup when it happens and a small number in the lower left corner.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43358829/1927e0ff4b0faa326a7c7b6f964ec20b6bd41b54.gif[/img]
[/list]

[h3]Balance:[/h3]
[list]
[*] Pump's "Air Pumping" efficiency reduced by 50%.
[*] Hulk weight increased from 3 → 6.
[*] Icebiter weight increased from 6 → 16.
[*] Boomer weight increased from 4 → 10.
[*] Beetle weight increased from 7 → 25.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43358829/fd14802aa473428f3bae7019b10648cc5af9239f.gif[/img]
[*] Sniper Turret's projectile push force increased from 80 → 130.
[*] New challenge curve for Hard Difficulty: Slightly easier at the beginning, 50% harder around mission #1000.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43358829/6384a4b45f7e9ec9ff61fc8a83fbf7819b561e83.jpg[/img]
[*] Missions are guaranteed to have a mission modifier per 150 challenge levels.
[*] Loop Event now has a stronger impact.
[/list]

[h3]Change:[/h3]
[list]
[*] Enemies will push and block each other less. Pushing is based on weight.
[*] Printed Soldiers expire after 2 minutes.
[/list]

[h3]Fixes:[/h3]
[list]
[*] Sniper and Ray Turrets will shoot fewer friendly soldiers.
[*] Fixed the issue where languages might not be applied correctly at startup when using a different language than the system’s default.
[*] Saving functions are now wrapped in safety nets.
[*] Unity upgraded from 2022.3.55f1 → 2022.3.58f1
[/list]

Thank you for all the kind words, patience and support as we make this game better together!

notes.title: Patch Notes: Build 0.96 "Selection Outline"
notes.content:
This update brings a new and improved selection, making it easier to see what’s selected. 32 new tips have been added to the loading screen, please let me know if you have more suggestions for tips! Room items now display current/max counts to communicate that there is a limit per type and when it has been reached.

[h3]Added:[/h3]
[list]
[*] New Selection Outline. A fresh cool outline highlight replaces the old boring selection ring.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43358829/91a8563cce10b13b670397b0d3af01a81f261fa1.gif[/img]
[*] Room Tooltips now show current and max count.
[*] 32 Loading Screen Tips to help you play smarter and find out about hidden features. Like:
[list][*] [i]Tip: Cold enemies are slower but tougher.[/i]
[*] [i]Tip: Raids stay active until completed or abandoned.[/i]
[*] [i]Tip: Hold SHIFT in "No Move" missions to skip confirmation.[/i]
[*] [i]Tip: Lightning Storms avoid hitting mission-critical buildings.[/i]
[/list][/list]


[h3]Balance:[/h3]
[list]
[*] Room rewards are now more spread out on the planet.
[*] Shotgun Range reduced from 12.5 → 10 (Max: 20 →  16).
[*] Soldier Printer's "Air Printing" Upgrade actually slows down production with 50%.
[*] Minigun Default Rotation Rate (Aim Speed) increase from 250 → 500.
[*] Minigun Default Range Reduced from 15 → 12 (Max: 21).
[/list]

[h3]Changes:[/h3]
[list]
[*] Minigun Rotation Rate (Aim Speed) upgrade is replaced with a Range upgrade. (Upgrade level is moved over)
[*] Refinery Missions now ask for confirmation before leaving when clicking "Complete".
[*] Disabled Buildings can no longer be selected.
[*] Drop Pod & SkyGun now have better audio cues when ready.
[*] Adding and removing patrol points now have better audio.
[*] Printed Soldier Death effect is now prettier.
[*] "Protect Deep Drill" Objective is removed once completed.
[*] Raid Names now include difficulty levels.
[*] Falcon Space Upgrades in the loadout screen are hidden once maxed out.
[/list]

[h3]Fixes:[/h3]
[list]
[*] Tons of Dialogue spelling mistakes fixed! Huge thanks to Paul Z. for the help!
[*] Elite Drop Pods are now less frame-rate dependent and should always spawn the correct amount.
[*] The "Complete Mission" button on Refinery Missions only appears when the mission is actually completed.
[*] Hero patrol points updates correctly when deselected.
[*] "Bunker" Achievement has been removed.
[*] SkyGun 500k Achievement text is now correct.
[*] Under Siege now displays the correct Mission Objectives.
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43358829/faf6e2218f9926df5d73bda79930e616554340d8.gif[/img]
Every update is built on your feedback, so keep sharing your thoughts! Whether it’s a bug, an idea, or just something that doesn’t feel right, I’m listening. Thanks for being part of making IDUN better! ♥

notes.title: Patch Notes: Build 0.95 "Achievements Tracker"
notes.content:
This update brings an in-game Achievement Tracker, so you can keep track of those that are not on Steam and it will help finding out why certain Steam achievements aren't triggering for some players. The two late game missions, Gulch and Spiral, are now Refinery missions with new random challenges every time they are started. Long range heroes and turrets are now really good at hitting fast moving distant targets.

[h3]Added:[/h3]
[list]
[*] In-Game Achievement Tracker. See all achievements and their progress, including those not on Steam (Steam has a 100-achievement limit for smaller games).
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43358829/b286797f8a2b762183ec4d20431fbea3a87af522.gif[/img]
[*] The missions Gulch & Spiral's challenges are randomized each time they load.
[/list]

[h3]Balance:[/h3]
[list]
[*] Rayn’s Special now has the same range as his base weapon (significantly increased).
[*] Bride starts using her electric ability from further away.
[*] Circle Selection (Neoteric) hold delay reduced from 0.4s → 0.3s.
[*] Gulch's challenge increased from 50 → 100.
[*] Spiral's challenge increased from 35 → 90.
[/list]

[h3]Changes:[/h3]
[list]
[*] Sniper & Ray Turrets now switch targets less often.
[*] Holding the Selection Modifier key (Default: SHIFT) now skips confirmation in "No Move" missions.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43358829/3d8b20803e15ba1889f6ffafdafaddb09d944811.gif[/img]
[*] Room Tooltip now includes "Click and Hold to drag Rooms."
[*] Howitzer, Rocket Artillery, Sniper & Ray Turrets got even smarter targeting.
[*] Gulch & Spiral are now Refinery missions.
[*] Temperature is now taken into account when calculating projectiles interception point.
[*] Heroes and Turrets have better targeting at long range against fast enemies.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43358829/28e494291f6c182c482fbe72de5b6636542794ce.gif[/img]
[*] Minefield Reinforcement Modifier now applies to Elite Drop Pods.
[*] The "Push" mission's Monster Base is now much harder to kill without the Nuke.
[*] Resource Bar stays active while trading.
[*] Hovering over the sides of the Resource Bar displays all planet resources.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43358829/ee5ee34e32cec3ab195783ed235a2a67f92f4d9d.jpg[/img]
[/list]

[h3]Fixes:[/h3]
[list]
[*] Carbon Steel Rewards now display correctly (previously, Nano Alloy was sometimes shown instead).
[*] Rayn’s Range is now displayed correctly.
[*] Loop Event Enemies now appear properly after the 10th loop.
[*] The Bomber in the "Frostburn" mission no longer flies away at the start if you restart after it has flown off.
[*] Mech no longer spins randomly when out of targets.
[*] Mech will be pushed out of any collider, preventing it from getting stuck.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43358829/92b00f36397a1dd7a8179c985a3232e8ec3c339f.gif[/img]
[/list]


As always, your feedback is what shapes the game, keep it coming!

notes.title: Patch Notes: Build 0.94 "Resource Tracker"
notes.content:
Last patch shipped with a bug related to Steam Overlay, so I needed a fix out ASAP. But I took this opportunity to get in some other requested quick fixes in and the resource tracker I have been working on.

[h3]Added:[/h3]
[list]
[*] Resources are now shown on the map when hovering over the resource bar, and rooms appear when hovering over the station button, making it easier to find what you need.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43358829/5bcb93f0b87b15f2fc6c1ab10c0862a09a628542.gif[/img]
[/list]

[h3]Balance:[/h3]
[list]
[*] Drop Pod impact liquid removal strength reduced from 10 → 2.
[*] Mech Health Upgrade cost increased from 75 → 150.
[*] Ray Turret fire rate increased from 0.5 → 0.75.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43358829/49226c88304e96d2c0983e84712059cde37ab496.gif[/img]
[/list]

[h3]Changes:[/h3]
[list]
[*] Preferred difficulty is now set to Easy by default.
[*] Improved the Turret Targe Prioritization. Added some gifs to show what is happening under the hood. The green line is the decided target. Blue is what the old system would have found. Red is blocked. Yellow is the search position and the cyan is the enemy that the position found. Hope you like this even though it is a bit nerdy. : )
[list]

notes.title: IDUN - New Circle Select / Multi Drag
notes.content:
[h2]What[/h2]
Circle Select allows you to quickly and efficiently select multiple turrets with a simple click-and-drag motion. This makes moving a lot of stuff way easier.


[h2]How[/h2]
[olist]
[*] Activate: Click and hold the on a draggable,
[*] Wait: Keep still until the circle select becomes active
[*] Resize: Move away to create a circular selection area.
[*] Release: Finalize your selection by releasing.
[*] Drag: Click and drag one of the selected and watch the magic happen!
[/olist]

[h2]Why[/h2]
Its been requested more than once, to be able to move many things at the same time. Imagine you want to fall back to defend the Deep Drill or cover another flank,
But, it is not as easy as it sounds to implement a system to move several buildings at the same time. What happens if there is no valid position, or when finding a new valid position another building also wants to move there? I also have the design goal for the game to be playable with just one mouse button, to maintain accessibility. The solution was easy for me, I just made John do it! It was not easy for John though. : ) 

[b]Big shout out to John who did the majority of the work!
[/b]

[h2]Nordic Game[/h2]
As a side note, I showed IDUN at Nordic Game here in Sweden. It was great fun as always to lure people in that normally don't play RTS games, and see them killing their way to a close success in the end. Lots of high fives. : )
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43358829/325f1874a2ca1f3bdce1b98e7d3507e7b506ba68.jpg[/img]

We’re looking forward to your feedback as always and thank you for your support!

/Gustav
